notes:
- Upscale: models now download from GitHub (no more http_404), the download screen shows only for the models you need, clearer error messages, and you can load models from a folder
- Search: a "This folder | Everywhere" switch – click again to go back to the folder you were in
- Hidden folders: junctions like "Documents and Settings" and dot-folders (.cache, .git) are hidden together with hidden files
- Tabs and the window title use the same folder names as the tree (Downloads, Desktop, Documents…)
- Add-ons: red "Remove" button with a confirmation; the add-on switch looks like everywhere else
- Clearer texts in Settings (3D preview, thumbnail cache, timeline), GIFs only under Images, one name "Clean-up", and a quieter status bar
